_what: SPEC (Phase 2, Stage 3, criteria C5 + C6) for the closed MOUTH of case cat1, built as SKIN STRUCTURE (layer L3, E5: no painted line). Inventory parts covered: philtrum meets the lip, upper lip lobes overhanging the lower lip, MOUTH CREASE (closed), mouth-corner (commissure) creases, lower lip and chin. Written by the 'mouth' builder agent; no geometry built here.
status: spec v1, 2026-10-18; NOT reviewed (A15: needs one narrow review)
frame: head frame of tripo_rebuild/partition.head_local, mm (world*1000): x = cat's LEFT, y = back (face at -y), z = up. Arc s = mm along the lip line from the midline junction.
evidence_ranking: G3: photo where it sees > constraints > Tripo reference (Phase 1 numbers with their uncertainty) > cited anatomy > estimate (flagged). Every value carries source + confidence (G2). Tripo artefacts (an open V groove with no lips, no undercut and no slit - REVIEW_mouth s1/s6) are NOT copied as anatomy; Tripo gives only WHERE the line runs.

confidence_scale.high: measured twice independently, agreeing within tolerance
confidence_scale.medium: one measurement or a measured reference with stated uncertainty
confidence_scale.low: read from a figure, or an inference from anatomy without a number
confidence_scale.estimate: no source for the number; a stated choice, range given

The upper-lip face recedes ~32 deg from vertical toward the apex (x=0).

photo.what: cases/cat1/ref.jpg (1728x1152); crops and luminance profiles by this agent (scratch photo_prof.py, photo_band.py)

reighard1901.cite: Reighard J. & Jennings H.S. (1901) Anatomy of the Cat. Henry Holt, New York. Alimentary canal, 1. The Mouth, p. 221
reighard1901.says: lips are 'thick folds of skin bounding the entrance to the mouth cavity'; outer surface hairy, inner surface mucous membrane; the upper lip has a 'deep external groove' in the midline running up toward the nasal septum (philtrum) and a thick median frenulum with large papillae beside it inside; the lower lip has a median frenulum and is attached to the jaw just behind the canine (between canine and first premolar); the lips meet at the commissura labiorum, where they join the cheek.

wikivet_lips.says: 'Feline's lips are smaller in size and have decreased motility'; 'Skin and mucosa meet at the lip margins.'

occlusion.cite: dvm360 proceedings 'Normal occlusion or malocclusion question' (search-result summary; page not opened by this agent, so confidence low)
occlusion.says: normal feline occlusion = scissor bite; the mandibular canine crown sits in the diastema between maxillary I3 and the maxillary canine; canines contacting the outer lip surface is a sign of malocclusion (so in normal occlusion the lips drape over the canines).

engine_anatomy.says: upper lip clearly larger than the lower (carnivores), split by the philtrum into two lobes -> overhang; lip margins pigmented (lentigo sites); commissure position: not found.

engine_hair.says: 'The nose tip, the lips and the paw pads are naked' (read together with Reighard 1901, which says the outer lip face is hairy: 'naked' = the labial margin).

engine_layered.says: the closed mouth shows as the shadow under the overhanging lips, not a drawn line; mouth crease where the upper lips overlap the lower lip; corner creases; checked in clay close-ups.

searched_not_found: the cat's commissure position relative to the teeth (premolar / carnassial level): two text searches on 2026-10-18 found no source (agrees with cat-anatomy.md 'not found')
any measured overlap of the upper lip over the lower lip in cats: two text searches found no source

The frozen camera (cases/cat1/camera_frozen.json, rms 3.9 px) was fitted to the v-series model; the nose builder's 2D-shift registration ties it to the head frame (registered_projection below; 2.79-2.88 px/mm = 0.35-0.36 mm/px at the mouth, agreeing with this scale within its uncertainty).

Resolved by the registered projection (below, O2): the photo's notch is the Y where the lobes part; Tripo's apex is the lower lip's contact 3.55 mm lower in z, hidden in the shadow.

Its x (-0.5) and this spec's mirror plane (+0.25) differ by 0.75 mm, inside the registration's ~1 mm: the builder takes ONE midline (suggest +0.25, the measured muzzle mirror plane) for both.

It is the lower lip's contact with the overhang at the midline (photo_evidence.registered_projection), 3.55 mm below the Y in z.

junction_philtrum_meets_lip.confidence: medium-low (Y, photo through a ~1 mm registration) / medium (contact, Tripo)

The philtrum groove itself belongs to the nose spec (inventory L3[4]); this spec builds the notch below the Y.
junction_philtrum_meets_lip.shape: the notch: the two lobes' medial margins run from the Y down and out to the margin line Gamma_U at s ~1.5-2.5 (photo: 30-40 deg below horizontal for the first ~2.5 mm, then the line's ~15-21 deg). Notch height Y -> contact 3.55 +-0.9 mm in z. The hidden overlap v is smallest here (see profiles): the lower lip is nearly exposed in the notch.

mouth_crease_line.what: the closed mouth = TWO lines: the upper-lip MARGIN Gamma_U (the lower edge of the lobes, the visible mouth edge) and, 1-2 mm below and behind it in the shadow, the CONTACT line Gamma_env where the lower lip meets the overhang. Built as a real overhanging fold over a hidden slot: never a cut slit, never a painted or engraved line (inventory L3[6], layered-build E5).

gamma_U_margin.what: the upper-lip margin on the envelope: in the envelope's section through Gamma_env(s) perpendicular to the line, the point on the upper-lip side whose z is Gamma_env.z + u_m(s)
gamma_U_margin.interp: linear between knots; s = 0 is the Y (the notch top), s 1.5-12.8 from the photo (registered_projection, mean of R and L), s > 12.8 not seen by the photo: linear to 1.0 at s_c-4 then cosine to 0 at the corner (ESTIMATE)
gamma_U_margin.source: PHOTO (J2: the photo sees the crescent) through the registered camera; supported by REVIEW_mouth s3 (Tripo texture band 0.5-1.9 mm above the apex)

gamma_env.what: the CONTACT line on the FUR ENVELOPE (Tripo's geometric apex), symmetrized. Left side below; right side = mirror about x=+0.25 (x_R = 0.5 - x_L). Built from mouth.json as 0.5*(L(s) + mirror(R(s))), except over arc 20.5-24.5 where R is contaminated by whisker-root spikes (L only there), then smoothed by a Gaussian of sigma 0.5 mm along s.
gamma_env.fit: max distance to the sound L line 0.38 mm; to the R line p90 1.04, max 1.68 mm at arc 23 (the whisker-root wiggle plus a ~0.5 mm y offset of R's central V, the Tripo asymmetry of REVIEW_mouth s4, which the photo does not show: the photo crescent is symmetric to 1 px)
gamma_env.confidence: medium (Tripo +-0.5; the symmetric build is justified by the photo crescent's 29/29 px halves)

mouth_crease_line.gamma_skin: Gamma_C_skin(s) (contact) = closest point on the skin S to [Gamma_env(s) - d(s)*n_env(s)], and Gamma_U_skin(s) (margin) the same from Gamma_U_env(s); d = the C1 coat depth at that point (muzzle typical 1.2 mm, chin 1.5), n_env = the Tripo envelope's outward normal there. Log the closest-point moves: more than 0.5 mm means the skin and the depth map disagree there (a C3 finding, not a mouth fix).
mouth_crease_line.why_structure_not_inset: the Tripo groove is 0.8 mm deep at the midline and 0.1-0.4 mm laterally (P1_mouth 2 mm readings). That is SMALLER than the muzzle coat inset (1.2 mm) that C3b then smooths, so the skin build will erase it. The mouth therefore has to be built by the recipe below, not inherited from the inset.
mouth_crease_line.why_two_lines: Tripo has no undercut, so it FILLS the overhang: its surface runs from the lobe's front down a receding face (~32 deg from vertical at x=0) to the V apex where the lower lip starts. The photo's shadow crescent lies on that receding face, 1.1-2.3 mm above the apex. In the build the fill between Gamma_U and the lower lip's face becomes air (the cavity under the overhang that casts the photo's crescent).

upper_lip_lobes_overhang.what: each upper-lip lobe is a thick skin fold (reighard1901) whose free lower margin hangs IN FRONT of and BELOW the top of the lower lip, hiding it. Evidence: the photo never shows the lower lip; engine_anatomy (upper lip larger -> overhang); occlusion (the lips drape over the canines in normal occlusion).

sigma_step_mm.what: visible step: the upper lip's outer skin at its margin Gamma_U_skin stands sigma in front (along the skin normal) of the lower-lip face plane (recipe step 2); sigma = margin thickness t_m + gap g. It is an OUTPUT of the geometry (margin from the photo, lower-lip face from Tripo); the profile here is the EXPECTED value and the build fails P2 if it comes out outside the range.
sigma_step_mm.taper: cosine from 1.5 at s_c-5 to 0.5 at the corner s_c
sigma_step_mm.source: P1_sections_fig: envelope step 1.0 (x=0) and 1.5/1.75 (x=-4/+4) mm, 1 mm above the apex; skin step = envelope step +-0.3 (muzzle 1.2 vs chin 1.5 coat depths). Taper: the Tripo depth falls to 0.17 mm at the corner (P1_mouth).

v_overlap_mm.what: HIDDEN overlap: how far the upper-lip margin hangs below the top margin of the lower lip, measured along the slot behind the flap
v_overlap_mm.taper: cosine from 2.5 at s_c-4 to 0 at the corner
v_overlap_mm.source: ESTIMATE from anatomy without a number: upper lip larger than the lower (engine_anatomy); lips cover the canines in normal occlusion (occlusion); the photo never shows the lower lip along the visible arc (photo_evidence.lower_lip), so v > 0 everywhere on 0 < s < s_c, smallest at the midline notch where the lobes part

g_gap_mm.what: hidden gap between the upper lip's inner (mucosal) face and the lower lip's outer face
g_gap_mm.source: CONSTRUCTION value, not anatomy (in life the lips touch). It keeps the two lips separate solids so the slot is real (C6) and the jaw can open; it must be >= 2 voxels of the SDF grid.

profiles_along_arc.t_m_margin_mm: t_m = sigma - g (0.75 at the midline, 1.35 laterally): the flap thickness at its free edge

r_m_edge_radius_mm.source: ESTIMATE (a rounded margin, ~ t_m/2 at the midline)

D_in_mm.what: slot run inward (-n) above the lower lip's top margin before its rounded end (the start of the vestibule)
D_in_mm.source: ESTIMATE. If an oral-cavity / teeth solid exists (the engine's opening mouth), join the slot to it instead.

commissures.anatomy_note: the commissure (commissura labiorum) is where the lips meet and join the cheek (reighard1901). The lower lip is attached behind the canine, so the corner must lie caudal to the lower canine. Its position against the teeth was searched for and not found. Tripo's line ends here and turns UP the whisker pad's rear border; a true angulus oris further back under the cheek fur cannot be excluded -> OPEN O3.
commissures.beyond_the_corner: the groove that continues UP from the corner (L from arc 29, R without a break) is the whisker pad's REAR BORDER, not mouth. Do not build it as lip; hand it to the whisker-pad part.

commissure_creases.what: one short skin crease per side at the corner, set back under the whisker pad (inventory L3[7]): the fold where the closed lips meet the cheek
commissure_creases.path: from the corner, continuing the lip line's tangent at s_c (projected on the skin), caudally

depth_mm.source: ESTIMATE. Tripo's envelope is FLAT here (2 mm reading -0.05..0.04 over L arc 26.2-28.2): the fur hides it, so no Tripo value exists.

Its median frenulum is inside (reighard1901, interior: not built in Stage 3 unless the oral cavity is). Visible only as the shadowed face under the overhang (the photo crescent).

chin.photo: mound ~13.7 +-1.8 mm wide, lower border ~14.4 +-1.5 mm below the junction in the image plane

lower_lip_side_folds.build: skin crease 0.3 mm deep (envelope depth minus fur, ESTIMATE), 1 mm wide, 7.0 +-1.0 mm long (Tripo L/R 6.0/8.1)
lower_lip_side_folds.photo: the chin mound's edges at |x| ~6.8 +-0.9 mm against the folds' lower ends at |x| 4.9-5.2: they agree within ~1.6 mm (soft photo edges)
lower_lip_side_folds.confidence: low (could be a fur parting in Tripo's envelope; no anatomy source for a mentolabial fold in cats was searched)

furless_and_fur.labial_margin: a ~1 mm band either side of each lip's free margin, and the whole slot interior, carry NO fur (engine_hair: naked lips; wikivet_lips: mucocutaneous junction at the margin). Add 'lip_margin' to coat.json furless (rule: within 1 mm of the margin edges and inside the slot): hand-off to the C1/C14 owners.
furless_and_fur.fur_over_margin: upper-lip fur (muzzle, guard 3-7 mm) hangs over the margin at Stage 5 and makes the envelope V; the built envelope apex must land back on Gamma_env (probe P3b)
furless_and_fur.pigment: lip margins are pigmented in cats generally (engine_anatomy); in this white cat the midline junction reads pinkish in the photo (R-G ~33 at y 397-402). Stage 4.

sdf_recipe.units: head frame mm; f < 0 inside the skin; smax/smin = polynomial smooth max/min with radius k
inputs: f_S: skin SDF (tripo_rebuild/layers/skin.npz from skin_build.py; read only)
Gamma_env (parts.mouth_crease_line.gamma_env) and the coat depth d(x) from the C1 depth map
the profiles sigma(s), v(s), g, r_m, D_in and s_c from parts.upper_lip_lobes_overhang
steps: 1. Gamma_U_skin(s) (margin) and Gamma_C_skin(s) (contact) as in parts.mouth_crease_line.gamma_skin, sampled every 0.25 mm of arc, both sides, s in [0, s_c]; at s = 0 the margin is the Y junction (the notch top).

2. Frames. At Gamma_U_skin(s): n = grad f_S / |grad f_S| (outward), t = dGamma_U/ds, b = normalize(n x t) signed so that b.z > 0 (up the skin toward the nose). Lower-lip face plane LL(s): through Gamma_C_skin(s) with normal n_LL = the skin normal 1.0 mm below Gamma_C_skin along the skin (the lower lip's own face, continued upward behind the flap). sigma(s) := distance from Gamma_U_skin(s) to LL(s) along n - check it against the expected profile (fail outside its range: then the margin or the depth map is wrong, do not force it). e_up = the direction of LL(s) in the section, pointing up; e_in = -n.

3. Slot sheet Pi(s, w), a polyline in each (n, b) section. A: from Gamma_U_skin + 2.0 n - r_m b (outside, just under the margin) straight to P0 = the point of LL(s) + (g/2) n_LL at the margin's height. B: from P0 along e_up (on LL offset g/2) for v(s). C: from the end of B along e_in for D_in, closed by a round end of radius g/2. Loft the section polylines along s; as s -> s_c (v and sigma taper) the sheet shrinks to the corner point.
4. Signed distance to the sheet: delta(p) = distance to Pi, signed + on the UPPER side (the flap's side: the +n side of B, the +b side of A and C).
5. Zone Z(p): a tube of radius 8 mm round Gamma_U_skin and Gamma_C_skin with a 2 mm smoothstep edge, clipped at the corners (+1 mm round end). Outside Z nothing changes.
6. Upper lip: f_up = smax(f_S, g/2 - delta, r_m): the skin on the upper side of the sheet, cut back to the flap's inner face, with the margin edge rounded to r_m.

7. Lower lip: f_LL = f_S below Gamma_C_skin, and the signed distance to the plane LL(s) above it (behind the flap, up to the lower lip's top margin), blended over 1 mm at Gamma_C_skin; f_lo = smax(f_LL, delta + g/2, 0.4). This REMOVES Tripo's fill between the margin and the lower lip's face (the cavity under the overhang that casts the photo's crescent), keeps the lower lip and chin where Tripo has them below the contact line, clips the lower lip to the lower side of the sheet and rounds its top margin by 0.4 mm.

8. f_mouth = Z * min(f_up, f_lo) + (1 - Z) * f_S. Commissure creases: f_mouth += a 1 mm-wide Gaussian groove along each crease path with the depth profile of parts.commissure_creases, continuous with the slot's tip at the corner.
9. Lower-lip side folds: the same groove operator, 0.3 mm deep, along the symmetric fold paths.
10. Re-mesh at <= 0.25 mm inside Z: the slot gap is 0.15 mm and the mesher must resolve it, otherwise it fills (see the P2 planted failure).
invariants: no fur and no paint are used to make the line (E5)
the two lips are separate surfaces across the slot everywhere on 0 < s < s_c (C6)
symmetric about x = +0.25 within 0.3 mm (built symmetric; the photo shows no asymmetry)
outside Z the skin is untouched (identical f)

P1_junction.how: sagittal section of the built skin at x = +0.25, and a frontal view along +y
pass: a notch: in the frontal view the lobes part below the Y (spec_nose point, inset to the skin, within its tol) and the notch reaches down 3.55 +-0.9 mm in z to the midline contact
the slot opens in the notch: a ray along -y at x = +0.25, 1 mm below the Y, crosses no upper-lip skin and meets the lower lip / slot (gap >= 0.1 mm)
the lobe margins leave the Y at 25-45 deg below horizontal over the first 2.5 mm
planted_failures: lobes merged (no notch; gap filled for s < 2)

P2_overhang_sections.how: exact sections of the built skin perpendicular to Gamma_U_skin at s = 2, 7, 12 (photo-visible) and 20 (hidden) on BOTH sides: 8 sections. In each: (a) sigma = the distance along n between the upper margin's outer skin and the lower lip's outer skin 1 mm below the margin; (b) walking from P0 up along e_up: flap solid (thickness t_m +-0.3), then an empty gap g in [0.1, 0.3], then lower-lip solid, for the length v(s) +-0.5: the upper lip lies outside the lower lip with a hidden gap; (c) a ray along -n (and along the frozen-camera ray once registered) at every h in [0, v] hits upper-lip skin first: the lower lip's top margin is never visible from the front.
planted_failures: butt joint: v = 0 (slot straight in) -> (b) fails
drawn line: a 0.2 mm groove with no slot -> (a) and (b) fail
